Once the line is lost, the line-loss rule drives the robot away from the tape until it leaves the track. Iteration 3 widened the sensor array to x = ±0.03 and moved it forward to y = 0.06, which raised the score to 49.94, mainly through slower progress on the s-bend (0.15). The footprints also overlap more, so the sum of readings stays above the 0.05 threshold on curves.\n(2) Weights: 7 antisymmetric weights [-1.5, -1.0, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5].
